note: Boise County (ID) zones its unincorporated land under the Unified Land Use Ordinance #2016-01 (amended 2024-02), but the county publishes only PDF ordinance text and a generalized future land use map. Its ArcGIS parcel viewer and property site show parcels, streets and hydrography, with no zoning district layer. ArcGIS Hub and Online searches for Boise County zoning returned only FEMA floodplain layers. No city in the county (Idaho City, Horseshoe Bend, Garden Valley area) was found publishing a queryable zoning layer.
